matchups.tips: | Impossible matchup. He outdamages you every time!
| He has great early game but you scale a lot better. Try to dodge cleavers, survive laning phase, get antiheal and Divine Sunderer. You pretty much outheal him and outdamage him anytime.
| Get antiheal and he isn't a champion. You can also block his E.

| Early on she can be annoying but then you win. And you win pretty much until late game... | In laning phase get sheen as fast as possible and poke her. Go for short trades. You block her E and since she doesn't go flash that often you block her only mobility.

| Early on he outdamages you hard but you outscale him easily. Dodge his Q's in laning phase and don't fight with him that often. You can understimate him and he will make you suffer for it. Don't fight him that much until Divine.

| Well. Fiora is Fiora. Get bramble as fast as possible since she heals so much. It's a skill matchup. She deals a lot of damage and you can also deal a lot of damage to her. You can W her Q but she can W it as well which makes it hard. Play smart.
| He will poke you a lot and he can outscale you but it isn't that impossible. Grab Doran's Shield and Second Wind and you can win lane and maybe then even a game.
| Early on be careful of his damage. | Get Sheen and poke him a lot. Go for short trades. After Divine he isn't really a champion for you until he has 4 items. Then he's a champion again!

| Early on he can poke you a lot but somehow you can manage to survive it without Second Wind or Doran's Shield. Rush Sheen and poke him too. You block his E and outdamage him easily. Just don't understimate his early game.
| You outdamage him, outrade him easily at any point of the game. And you block his E.
| Beware of her cheese on early levels and you're good to go. Rush Sheen, poke her and trade with her. You block her E.
| Don't try to come closer to him. He will push so your jungler can come and you can punish him. Go for Magic Resists or some Damage to one shot him.
| You block her W and outtrade her and outdamage her if you dodge her E anytime.
| Early on she can cheese you, be careful. Get Bramble Vest, go for short trades. Get Sheen and poke her. After Divine you win.
| Same as Irelia. Early on he can cheese you, be careful. Get Bramble Vest, go for short trades. Get Sheen and poke her. After Divine you win.
| He'll poke you early a bit but you outtrade him easily. You block his Hammer Q. You have better laning phase and mid game but late game... Let's hope it never goes to that.
| Early on she can be powerful with Lethal Tempo but Sheen and your laning phase makes her life painful.
| Kennen can pretty much be annoying since he's a ranged champion. His CC is a pain as well. Try to scale, survive laning phase and play with your team.
| Beware of his 1,2 levels and then you outtrade him easily anytime. You block his E and melt him with Q.

| If your team has magic champions then this matchup won't be hard. You trade with him easily and just get Divine and outdamage him. | If your team has only AD Champions... Well then you're going to have a painful game.
| He isn't really a sololane champion. You outtrade him and outdamage him anytime. Get sheen, poke him and after Divine it's gg.

| Mordekaiser can be deadly early on when he can pull you but if you play smart you can win it easily. Make sure to dodge his E and short trade with him. After Divine you can pretty much outdamge him.
| You outtrade him easily and negate him from stacking minions. Even if he stacks you'll get Divine and you'll outdamage him anytime.
| As a tank, Ornn has not a bad damage. Trade with him early on and try to buy Divine as fast as possible. Then you outdamage him anytime. You block his E and R recast.
| He has pretty good early game which you should not understimate. You block his W. Go for short trades. Get Sheen and poke him. You outscale him pretty fast.
| Early on she can poke you a lot but with armor items you can outdamage her. Try to survive poke and then kill her. You block her E.

| Renekton is pretty much an easy matchup. Be careful of his early levels and then you are good to go. Grab Sheen and poke him. You outscale him quickly. You can also buy Bramble Vest if you think he heals too much.
| Be careful of first levels. Grab Bramble Vest as fast as possible. You can W his leap and outtrade him. After Bramble Vest he doesn't really do damage.
| Beware of her first levels. Then go for short trades. Go for Sheen and poke her. You outscale her.
| Rumble is rarely seen nowadays. Beware of his Q damage and try to outscale him. Get Sheen and poke him. Go for short trades if you can.
| Go for short trades. And grab Bramble Vest asap. You outtrade him, outdamage him, outscale him easily.
| Beware of his early game damage. Go for short trades and dodge his E. Grab Sheen and poke him. You outtrade him and outdamage him then if you play smart. After Divine it's gg.
| Beware of his Q damage. Try to not get taunted, W his E. You outscale him easily.
| You can easily Q him and runaway or just outtrade him, outdamage him and outscale him anytime.
| He can pretty much be tanky and he can outduel you but don't worry. Go for short trades early on, go for Sheen and poke him. And get Divine and play smart.
| You outrade him, outdamge him anytime. He isn't a problem when he isn't a champion against you. You can block his E wih W.
| Try to survive laning phase and call your jungler for help. Punish Teemo.
| Be careful of his cheese early on. Get Bramble Vest or Sheen and you outdamage him anytime. You can W his E.
| Beware of his first 3 levels. You outtrade him anytime then. You block his Q. Grab Sheen and poke him too. Grab Bramble Vest if he heals too much.
| Grab antiheal as fast as possible. Go for short trades and get divine asap too. His laning phase insane.
| You can block his E and W. You can outtrade him easily and outdamage him too. Beware of his R damage. It can be hurtful.
| Yasuo is like Yone. You can go Bramble Vest and just eliminate him from the game. You can go anything and outdamage him anyway. You block his E.
| Free matchup. Yone is a bad champion that won't deal damage to you. You can easily go anything and outdamage him. Bramble Vest just eliminates him from the game. And you block his Q3.
| If you dodge his E you can outtrade him and outdamage him anytime. | Beware of his splitpushing potential.

| Olaf is a difficult champion to deal with. His rework made him even stronger at dueling. Beware of his early cheese with Q. Dodge his axes if possible. Take short trades. Try to escape from his R if he will activate it like Heroic Charge the minion. Try to get Sheen first and then Divine Sunderer. Then you can fight him.

| Early on you can outtrade him easily. | After 6 beware of his ult. It grants stats that can one shot you (literally). | You block his dash. Don't come close near his tower or he will ult you. Don't understimate him.

| Swain is weird champion... | Early on you can win trade easily but later it's random. When he has ult he will heal off you. You can use ult to knock him out and disable it. He is useless without ult.
| As for tank Sejuani has great damage but she quickly falls off against Poppy. You block her dash on Q.
| Beware of Akshan's early game. He can one shot you with few autoattacks. You block his dash on E so use it against him. You can easily outdamage him after some levels and some components.
| Very annoying matchup as she will poke you very often. You can outdamage her early on if you play smart, you block her Q. It's probably the best to ask for gank.
| Her gameplay can be very annoying and without thinking she can deal you a lot of damage. You block her dashes on E and R. Try to buy some Magic Resists and poke her in lane.
| You can W his E and his mobility is gone. Try not to get kited and don't let him stack armor.
| You can W his Q and his engage is gone. He can't R after blocked dash. Beware of R + Flash. Be careful of his damage, it can be hurtful.
| Big damage output, especially on teamfights. Try to stop him channeling, throw him out or stun him after engage to don't let him do full damage combo.
| Can't do anything since you block his E. Even if he decides to engage you just stun him and it's over for him. You outdamage him early on and maybe later if you decide to snowball.
| Jungler that just dominates early game. Her damage is big and she can one shot you at any time. Ward your jungle because she likes to invade as well and look for picks.
| He's a scaling jungler and his early damage is low. He will go straight onto your carry to burst him down, try to stun him as much as possible. You can W his E roll.
| Invisible assasin that melts carries. Try to stun her any time. Beware of the charm and magic damage she has.
| You can W his Q but besides that he's annoying. He's giving shield every 2-3 seconds. Try to buy Serpent's Fang.
| You stop his E+Q engage and can stun him to his own wall. Free win.

| Early on you have to snowball asap because this guy is a ticking bomb. You somehow let him scale and it's over. His damage output is huge and you have to finish the game before late game. Otherwise stack tons of magic resists or just play like a god.
| You stop his dashes on Q and W. Easy to kill since he doesn't have damage after that.
| You can block her dash and stun her, don't get kited tho.
| You can stop his E but how your gonna stop his invisibility and one shotting squishies. His damage output is so broken and mobility as well.
| He can easily engage into ADC and let them suffer but you can easily shred buying armor penetration. His mobility around the map is amazing and don't understimate him.
| He's gonna gank every lane every few seconds while one shotting camps. It's the way I see it. You can focus and shred him when you will buy some items tho. You can cancel his R as well.
| Beware of her sleep and kiting that can be annoying. She can outdamage you if you play wrong.
| You block his Q and he's left without damage and mobility during fights. Easy to stun and to kill then.
| Early - you stun him and kill him because he deals no damage. | Late - you better stun him or he one shots you.
| You block her dash on cougar form and she doesn't do much damage if she misses spear.
| Easily outdamaged in midgame and easily stunned. Be careful of his early game and his ults...
| You can block her tunneling dash or path, whatever that is. And you can easily outdamage her. Beware of her True Damage. It can hurt.
| Whether it's AP or AD or Tank Shyvana I didn't see a problem with her, she doesn't have ganking tools.
| He can pretty much rob your ADC and win the game by that. You outdamage him. You both have utility to help team so use it the best.
| Shaco. He's annoying and will snowball and make everyone's life a pain. Whether it's AD or AP Shaco you're not gonna have a good time.

| Don't try to get him ahead in early game. His damage is huge but if you snowball he won't deal that much in early game. After Divine you easily outdamage him but be careful about his post Demonic Embrace damage...

| Trundle is very hard to beat but it's not impossible. | He outdamages you not only early, but mid and late game as well. Because of his Q that steals AD and R that steals resistances you're gonna have a bad time dueling him. Even in teamfights he can just steal your resistances and go to your carry. With Divine you can match him but don't ever understimate him. He heals a lot as well so probably buy Thornmail too.
| You block her predictable basic engage tool on Q and outdamage her. Easy matchup.
| Xin can match your damage in early game but he's easily countered when you will buy items. You can block his E as well. He isn't that strong as some months ago but he's not bad.
| You outdamage her early on. You block her E dash. Try to deny her scaling.
| You easily block her mobility and with that you outdamage her. Just be aware of her E.
| He's really easy to beat as he's assasin and you are Poppy! You can block his dashes with Steadfast Presence and outdamage him anytime anywhere. Don't let him snowball though.
| Same as Talon. You easily outdamage him anytime anywhere. Just go with a little armor and you're good to go.

| Brand's AP max %hp damage can be really disgusting. Be sure to buy at least Mercury's Treads, his CC combined with slows from Rylai is irritating. If possible more magic resist. He doesn't have any dashes so once you engage onto him he's really easy to kill but of course don't understimate his poke-burst-oneshot gameplay.

| Briar doesn't stand a chance against you. She doesn't deal damage and you can block her dashes (Q and W) with your Steadfast Presence (W). You outdamage her anytime, you can grab antiheal as well but without it that's enough anyway as your kit is created to stop these kind of champions.
